summary: read lidar or laser scan ranges; measure nearby walls, obstacles, free space, closest distance around the mobile robot
description: Reads current lidar or laser scan measurements. Output reports closest obstacle distance and directional ranges, for example 'front=2.4m left=1.1m right=3.8m rear=0.9m min=0.7m'. Extract the closest obstacle, useful directional distances, and whether the robot has clear space. Does not accept parameters.
